name: Chocolatier (Artisan)
tagline: A warm, working storefront for an artisan chocolatier.
description: A complete, working shop for a bean-to-bar chocolatier: a real catalogue of single-origin bars, truffle and confection boxes, drinking chocolate, gift sets and a flexible subscription, with categories, collections, a bespoke PDP and a fully merchandised home page. Rich, low-lit chocolate-room theme — deep cocoa grounds, a burgundy primary, a warm gold accent. Shipped as Cacao & Co.
